title: Protect Lockfiles
summary: A Claude Code hook that blocks hand edits to package-lock.json, yarn.lock, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock and other lockfiles the package manager owns.
description: A lockfile pins exact versions and integrity hashes. A hand edit, even a small one, can break installs or hide a downgrade, so this PreToolUse hook refuses Edit and Write calls that target one.

Fifteen common lockfile names are covered, from npm and yarn to Cargo, Poetry, Composer, Bundler and Go. The agent is told to change the manifest and run the install command, which keeps the lock honest.
useWhen: Stop merge-conflict fixes that rewrite a lockfile by hand
Keep dependency changes going through the package manager
Review agent diffs without wading through lock noise

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'').split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');const n=f.split('/').pop();const names=['package-lock.json','yarn.lock','pnpm-lock.yaml','bun.lock','bun.lockb','npm-shrinkwrap.json','Cargo.lock','poetry.lock','Pipfile.lock','uv.lock','composer.lock','Gemfile.lock','go.sum','pubspec.lock','packages.lock.json'];if(names.includes(n)){console.error('Blocked: '+n+' is generated by the package manager. Change the manifest, then let the install command rewrite the lockfile.');process.exitCode=2}})"

example.prompt: Fix the conflict in pnpm-lock.yaml by keeping both versions.
example.result: The edit is refused. The agent resolves package.json, runs pnpm install and lets pnpm write a clean lockfile.

faq.question: Can the agent still update dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. Shell commands such as npm install or cargo update are not affected, only direct file edits and writes.

faq.question: How do I add another lockfile name?
faq.answer: Add the file name to the list inside the command, between the square brackets, keeping the single quotes.

access: Reads the target file path of each Edit and Write call
Blocks matching calls and changes no file itself
